email_subject: FINAL NOTICE: Invoice INV-0748 — Legal Action Pending in 48 Hours
email_body:
Dear Christopher Wheeler DDS,

This is a final notice regarding invoice INV-0748 for €6,781.66, now 120 days overdue. We have sent 1 prior communications, none of which have received a response.
